newsitem.title: USA: TEXAS UTILITIES OFFERS CUSTOM SERVICES.
newsitem.headline: TEXAS UTILITIES OFFERS CUSTOM SERVICES.

text.p: Texas Utilities Co said Wednesday it is offering a new service called Operational Solutions designed to provide such medium-sized businesses such as manufacturers, hospitals, schools and office buildings with customized "refined" energy services.

Under a single contract, the company said, Operational Solutions will own, operate and maintain energy-related equipment and systems aimed at improving the customer's performance, while freeing business owners to concentrate time and resources on their core businesses.

Chief executive Erle Nye introduced the new venture to 300 commercial and industrial customers, saying through the new unit Texas Utilities "will more closely align ourselves with customers by sharing in the business risk of implementing new systems."
